description: This is the main activity Java source file for an Android Wearable application. It manages connections to Google APIs, handles data and message events, manages UI components such as a view pager with multiple fragments, and interacts with wearable data items and assets.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity class managing the wearable device interactions, connection lifecycle, data updates, and UI navigation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up views, and builds the GoogleApiClient.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Connects the GoogleApiClient when activity resumes.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Removes listeners and disconnects the GoogleApiClient when activity pauses.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Callback when GoogleApiClient successfully connects; adds listeners for data, message, and capability APIs.

methods.name: onDataChanged
methods.description: Processes incoming data events, handles image assets, and updates UI fragments accordingly.

methods.name: onMessageReceived
methods.description: Handles incoming messages from connected devices.

methods.name: setupViews
methods.description: Initializes UI components such as view pager and fragments.

methods.name: moveToPage
methods.description: Switches the view pager to the specified page index.
